verdict.justification: Both deliverables provide the three required file types, leave event records blank, and correctly apply the governing USD 5,000 threshold rather than the unapproved USD 50,000 proposal. A is preferable because its approval controls are more explicit: “Final PM Lead sign-off may not be given while any required approval is missing or negative,” and its form separates formal and fast-track approval blocks. A also strengthens practical traceability with separate Client Name and Project/Program fields, versioned attachment references, and tracker columns for “Review Pathway” and “Signed Form Archive Reference.” B introduces inconsistent routing guidance by suggesting that shifts between one and two business days might qualify for fast-track, while Section 7.3 limits timeline impacts to a one-day adjustment. B also says “All changes are documented on the Change Request Form,” conflicting with its own outside-SOP pathway and creating unnecessary ambiguity for routine changes. A is longer than necessary and still needs its disclosed implementation dependencies resolved, but it offers the more coherent and operationally usable package for final review.

decisive_issues.issue: Explicitly prevents final approval with missing or negative required approvals.
decisive_issues.quote: Final PM Lead sign-off may not be given while any required approval is missing or negative.

decisive_issues.issue: Adds direct tracker-to-approval-route and archive links beyond the required columns.
decisive_issues.quote: The template also includes two supporting columns – Review Pathway and Signed Form Archive Reference – to link each entry to its approval route and archived record.

decisive_issues.issue: Fast-track eligibility for one-to-two-day shifts conflicts with the later one-day limit.
decisive_issues.quote: Assumption: such a shift may use fast-track only if it meets every fast-track condition in Section 7.3 as judged jointly by PM and QA

decisive_issues.issue: Blanket form requirement conflicts with the stated exclusion of routine changes from the SOP.
decisive_issues.quote: All changes are documented on the Change Request Form (template issued with this SOP).
